correctness.rationale: The finite claim is completely enumerated. One route builds every 7/3^+-power-free Dyck prefix while checking all newly created suffix factors; the other independently enumerates every Catalan word by choosing opening positions and tests every factor-period pair from scratch. They agree at every even length 8 through 24. No nesting-level-4 word occurs before length 24, exactly one occurs at 24, and its maximal exponent is exactly 7/3 via the period-3 factor 1001001.

value.rationale: Nesting level 4 is the first level ruled out by the source under non-strict 7/3 avoidance and restored when exact 7/3-powers are allowed. Determining the exact first witness length and the complete set of minimizers therefore quantifies the sharp threshold itself. The source construction gives length 228 at this level, while the exact optimum is 24, so the finite classification is a substantial sharpening rather than an arbitrary cutoff.
